definition: Privacy Lost is a 2023 short science fiction film directed by Peter Stoel and Robert Berger.
details: It follows a family using augmented reality (AR) and artificial intelligence (AI) devices capable of reading emotional states, raising questions about privacy and manipulation.
story: Picture a parachute packed by a second pair of hands: nobody plans to need it, but everyone is glad it was checked. The idea is simple: before something powerful is let loose, someone checks that it will not do real harm to real people. It is the habit of asking, before every launch, what could go wrong — and then doing something about it. Caution is not the enemy of progress — it is the reason progress gets to keep going. That deliberate caution is Privacy Lost.
